title: Minji & Daniel — Bilingual Mobile Wedding Invitation
client_fictional: Minji & Daniel (fictional international couple), wedding at The Hanok Garden, Seoul (fictional venue)
type: Bilingual mobile wedding invitation website (모바일 청첩장)
summary_en: A Korean-style mobile wedding invitation that works fully in Korean and English, with a one-tap language toggle, a live D-day countdown and a friendly “First Korean wedding?” guide for international guests. Includes gallery lightbox, map links, gift accounts with copy-to-clipboard and an RSVP form.
notes: Concept project. Couple, parents, venue, address, phone and bank accounts are fictional. Illustrations are AI-generated (no realistic faces) and art-directed for this concept. RSVP is front-end only; nothing is sent.
